def Spirale(Nom,N) :
    b = False
    while not(b):
        P=int(input("Choisir une position p: "))
        b  = 0 <= P < 10
    CH = ""
    for i in range(N) :
        CH += Nom[i][P]
    TP = array([str]*20)
    R = CH
    for i in range(N):
        TP[i] = R
        R = traitement(R)
    Afficher(TP,N)

def traitement(ch):
    d = 0
    g = len(ch)-1
    R = ""
    while len(R) < len(ch) :
        R = R  + ch[g] + ch[d]
        g -= 1
        d += 1
    if len(ch)%2 != 0 :
        R = R[:len(ch)]
    return R

def Afficher(TP,N):
    for i in range (N):
        print(TP[i])
